empty.title: Start with a series
empty.paste: Paste the link to a series in the bar above (or use its Paste button). A link to any of its chapters works too.
empty.listed: Its chapters will be listed here, ready to pick and save for your reader.

failed.title: Couldn't load this series
failed.hint: Check that the link opens the series in a browser. Sites behind a Cloudflare check may need Show the browser window, under Options › Advanced.

rangeLabel: Chapter range to add to the selection

parts.none: No chapter of this series is split in parts, so each one gets a file as usual.
parts.partialHint: Only the selected parts go in its file

locked: Locked, so it cannot be selected

duplicates.language: Some numbers are listed once per language; the language tag tells them apart.
duplicates.group: Some numbers are listed once per group; the group tag tells them apart.

hint.volume: Click a volume to pick all of its chapters · <kbd>←</kbd><kbd>→</kbd> fold · <kbd>Space</kbd> toggles
hint.part: Click a chapter to pick all of its parts · <kbd>←</kbd><kbd>→</kbd> fold · <kbd>Space</kbd> toggles
